title: Human Cognitive Benchmarks Reveal Foundational Visual Gaps in MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2502.16435v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Humans develop perception through a bottom-up hierarchy: from basic primitives and Gestalt principles to high-level semantics. Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are trained directly on complex downstream tasks. Does it guarantee their performance on these foundational visual capabilities? To systematically investigate this gap, we introduce VisFacor, a benchmark that digitizes 20 vision-centric subtests from FRCT, a well-established cognitive psychology assessment spanning four domains of human visual cognition. translated_title: 人类认知基准揭示多模态大语言模型的基础视觉能力差距
translated_abstract: 人类通过自底向上的层级结构发展感知能力：从基本图元和格式塔原则到高级语义。当前的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）直接在复杂的下游任务上训练，这能否保证它们具备这些基础视觉能力？为了系统地研究这一差距，我们提出了VisFacor基准，该基准将FRCT（一项成熟的认知心理学评估，涵盖人类视觉认知的四个领域）中的20个以视觉为中心的子测试数字化。此外，我们设计了算法来自动构建和验证具有可控难度的无限测试用例。使用VisFacor，我们评估了39个前沿的多模态大语言模型，包括专有模型（如GPT、Gemini）和开源模型（如LLaMA、Qwen）。表现最好的模型仅获得55.9%的分数。分析显示该基准具有良好的内部一致性（Cronbach's alpha = 0.94）和结构效度。
tldr: 该论文提出VisFacor基准，将认知心理学评估FRCT中的20个视觉子测试数字化，以评估多模态大语言模型的基础视觉认知能力，发现即使是最好的模型也仅得55.9%，揭示了当前模型在基础视觉能力上存在显著差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VisFacor, a benchmark digitizing 20 vision-centric subtests from the FRCT cognitive psychology assessment, revealing that even the best frontier MLLMs achieve only 55.9%, exposing foundational gaps in visual cognition capabilities of current multimodal models.
